system.description:
Your titanic strength never flags; unless sorely pressed or wounded, you can sustain incredible feats of power almost without end.

Whenever you enter a challenge of strength you may use Potence itself as your bid Trait. This Trait does not count toward totals when resolving ties or overbids, but it can never be lost, so you may use Potence again and again in successive tests of strength; only when you are forced to risk multiple Traits (through wounds or Negative Traits) do you risk your other Physical Traits. If you run out of Physical Traits you cannot use this power, and once wholly exhausted you can no longer enter challenges.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Disciplines
